text: I'm a qualified pastry chef with nine years of experience. I have recently been diagnosed as celiac, and I was disappointed by what's out there. So I've put my skills and knowledge together and I'm opening my own gluten-free artisan bakery. I'm currently taking custom cake orders and will be branching out into breads, desserts and all things sweet.

text: I have just the page for you to follow! glutenfree.bne on insta is a coeliac woman in Brisbane and she asks all the questions about safety etc and will post reviews and in her captions she will let you know if the place is 100% gluten free or if the place like Flour & Chocolate have a whole second kitchen just to make gluten free coeliac safe things or if the kitchen 'is aware' of safe practices and has a separate fryer so you can make an informed decision

text: we went to Groundhog Social at Manly a couple of weeks back and it has changed. Even though we questioned many times if the pancakes were indeed gf as the online menu and physical menu differed. He assured us they were but said there had been some changes.
